initial_window.consequence: Initial extraction run invalidated because its U01 input manifest no longer represented the current corpus.

observations: The file continued changing during short stability checks.
The extraction code opens corpus files for reading and writes only below the U02 artifact directory.
The user subsequently confirmed making the edit and undoing it.

response.action: An intermediate U01 rebaseline was generated for diagnosis. After the user restored the source, the corpus matched the original U01 manifest and U02 was rerun from the approved original manifest.
